(User-Identität)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="200" x="550" y="145" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="11" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#666666;" value="<font style="font-size:10px" color="#d6b656"><b>Conditions</b></font><br><font style="font-size:10px" color="#666666">Gültigkeitszeitraum + Zielgruppe</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="200" x="550" y="205" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="12" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#666666;" value="<font style="font-size:10px" color="#82b366"><b>AuthnStatement</b></font><br><font style="font-size:10px" color="#666666">Wann/Wie wurde authentifiziert?</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="200" x="550" y="265" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="13" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#666666;" value="<font style="font-size:10px" color="#d79b00"><b>AttributeStatement</b></font><br><font style="font-size:10px" color="#666666">Zusätzliche Attribute (Rollen, Gruppen...)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="200" x="550" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
